Registered office: Cluj-Napoca, 119 Calea Moților, Cluj County, Romania Telephone/fax: 0364.401.709/0364.401.710 Trade Register No.: 1994003038124 Tax identification number: 6738423; Share capital: RON 50,614,492.80 Regulated market on which the issued securities are traded: Bucharest Stock Exchange (BVB), Premium Category, symbol BRK Important event to be reported: Completion of the share buyback programme component approved on 16.09.2026 BRK Financial Group S.A. ("BRK" or the "Company") announces that, on 21 October 2026, it completed the component of the share buyback programme approved by the Board of Directors' Resolution dated 16.09.2026, within the limits and under the conditions approved by Resolution No. 2 of the Extraordinary General Meeting of Shareholders ("EGMS") dated 29.04.2026, by acquiring all 6,202,601 shares allocated to this component. This component provided for the repurchase of up to 6,202,601 BRK shares at a minimum price equal to the market price on the BVB at the time of purchase, but not less than RON 0.10 per share, and a maximum price of RON 0.20 per share, subject to a maximum aggregate value of RON 1,240,520.20, excluding commissions and other transaction costs. In its current report dated 16.09.2026, the Company announced the launch of this component. During the period 17.09.2026– 21.10.2026, a total of 6,202,601 shares were repurchased through BRK Financial Group S.A. on the regulated market operated by Bucharest Stock Exchange S.A., representing the entire number of shares allocated to this component. The Company also informs the regulated market of the following transactions executed under the BRK symbol during the period 19.10.2026–21.10.2026: Transaction type Trading venue 19.10.2026 Share buyback BVB 100,000 0.1570 15,700.00 20.10.2026 Share buyback BVB 100,000 0.1575 15,750.00 21.10.2026 Share buyback BVB 100,000 0.1535 15,350.00 300,000 0.1560 46,800.00 TOTAL Aggregate volume Volume-weighted average price (RON/share) Transaction date Value (RON) The Company reiterates that the purpose of repurchasing its own shares under this component is to use them for the employee stock option plan (ESOP). The completion announced in this report concerns the component approved by the Board of Directors' Resolution dated 16.09.2026. Ovidiu Dumitrescu Deputy General Manager

Bulevardul Iancu de Hunedoara 48, Bucharest Phone/fax: 021-203.82.00 / 021 - 316.94.00 Unique registration code at the Trade Register Office: 10874881 Commercial Register number: J199800740340409 Subscribed and paid-up share capital: 3.016.438.940 Regulated market on which issued securities are traded: Bucharest Stock Exchange To: Bucharest Stock Exchange Financial Supervisory Authority Important event to report: Societatea Nationala Nuclearelectrica S.A. ("SNN") has concluded 1 (one) legal act of the type referred to in Article 234 paragraph 1, letter i) of ASF Regulation no. 5/2018 on issuers of financial instruments and market operations.
